noita game sourced

Noita

A roguelite action game in which every pixel of the world is simulated as a falling-sand material that burns, melts, flows, and reacts, and the player builds wands from spells to dig through procedurally generated levels.

2019Nolla GamesPhysics sandboxcluster c0711 mechanics
this record asyaml sourcemarkdownjson

core loop

descend into a procedurally generated biome -> fight enemies with wands that also reshape the pixel world -> survive fire, liquids, and gases set off by fighting -> buy or find spells and rebuild wands at the Holy Mountain -> descend again or die and restart

design notes

Noita's Falling Everything engine simulates each pixel as a material with state (solid, powder, liquid, gas) and reaction rules, and solid bodies are Box2D rigid bodies that break into pixels when damaged. Because spells, enemies, and the player all act on that layer, combat routinely sets off chain events such as burning oil, steam explosions, flooding, and collapsing ceilings, and these kill the player as often as enemies do. Wand building composes spells with modifiers into programs with cast order and mana limits, and runs are permadeath.

The Powder Toy

uses

Falling-sand materials

Every pixel of terrain is a material that falls, flows, or rises by local rules, so digging, explosions, and spills reshape the level in real time.

core
uses

Material interactions

Materials react by rule: lava and water form rock and steam, wood burns into smoke, acid eats terrain, and alchemical liquids such as polymorphine or teleportatium apply their effects on contact.

core
uses

Modular assembly

Wands have stats such as capacity, mana, recharge, and cast delay; spells and modifiers placed in a wand's slots execute in order, so arrangement changes what the wand does.

core
uses

Permadeath

A death ends the run and the world is regenerated; only some unlocks, such as new spells in the pool, persist.

core
uses

Combination discovery

Each world seed defines two secret alchemy recipes (Lively Concoction and Alchemic Precursor), each made from three materials that players must find by experiment.

supporting
uses

Direct avatar control

The player controls one witch with levitation, kicking, and wand casting.

supporting
uses

Fire spread

Fire spreads through wood, grass, oil, and gunpowder and burns the player and enemies alike.

supporting
uses

Fluid and gas simulation

Liquids pool and flow and gases rise and spread through caves at pixel level.

supporting
uses

Modding API

Lua-based mods are supported and distributed through Steam Workshop.

supporting
uses

Procedural terrain

Each seed generates biome layouts from hand-made tile pieces within a fixed order of biomes.

supporting
uses

Rigid-body physics

Box2D rigid bodies such as crates, bricks, and detached terrain chunks can be kicked, thrown, and shattered.
